replies.author: SirCyaniide
replies.body:
Hey Otero,

The logs stated that you typed in "Hey oc.tc" Not once, but 4 times.

You deliberately posted an IP of some sort on our server. I warned you telling you "Please don't advertise" and yet you've seemed to fail at understanding the rules of this server. 

Considering this is NOT an actual server IP, I'll give you the benefit of doubt and appeal your ban. 


Please review the rules here before heading on back. 

Hope you enjoy your time here on Avicus!

SirCyanide - Avicus Moderator
